verdict.rationale: Grafana lets you define dashboards, data sources and other configuration as version-controlled files, and documents an API and CLI, so configuration can live outside the product. Its stack is built on open telemetry standards (OpenTelemetry pitched as 'protecting you from vendor lock-in and ensuring data portability'; Jaeger/Zipkin/OTel for Tempo; Prometheus/OTel metrics in Mimir), and self-managed Loki stores data in your own object storage or local filesystem. However, no evidence documents a bulk export of all stored telemetry, especially from Grafana Cloud, or an exit path; the only migration docs point into Grafana Cloud. Missing for 10: documented full-data export feature, Cloud exit/offboarding path, specification of export formats for stored metrics/logs/traces, independent hands-on corroboration of leaving.
